profile.org_note: Three reportable homebuilding segments (Northeast: DE, MD, NJ, OH, PA, VA, WV; Southeast: FL, GA, SC; West: AZ, CA, TX; FY2025 10-K) run in the field as an East Group (Northeast + Southeast; Michael Wyatt was its President through FY2025 and became COO on 2025-11-01, successor not disclosed) and a West Group, over divisions in 27 markets across 13 states, each with its own land team; group presidents are not executive officers and are not named in filings (aggregator leads only: Joseph F. Riggs, 'Group President', and Michael Fulmer, 'West Group President'). Land deals are sourced by division VPs of Land Acquisition and presented to senior leaders, with the CEO (chief operating decision maker), President Alexander Hovnanian, COO Michael Wyatt and CFO Brad O'Connor the decision-makers; no corporate head of land is publicly named, and the Treasurer (Paul Eberly per aggregators) is not named in filings.
profile.summary: Family-controlled public builder (NYSE: HOV, Matawan NJ; fiscal year ends Oct 31) delivering 5,496 consolidated homes plus 935 in joint ventures in FY2025 across 13 states, with the West (AZ, CA, TX) its largest segment by Q3 FY2026 revenue ($354M of $704M). It is one of the most land-light public builders: 87% of its 34,373 controlled lots were optioned at July 31, 2026, it uses sale-and-option-back land banking and JVs, and it is actively hiring VPs of Land Acquisition in Florida and Southern California. Leadership turned over on Nov 1, 2025: Alexander Hovnanian became President and Michael Wyatt COO under Chairman/CEO Ara Hovnanian.
